translations.web: Then the king went to his palace, and passed the night fasting. No musical instruments were brought before him; and his sleep fled from him.
translations.bsb: Then the king went to his palace and spent the night fasting. No entertainment was brought before him, and sleep fled from him.
translations.kjv: Then the king went to his palace, and passed the night fasting: neither were instruments of musick brought before him: and his sleep went from him.
translations.asv: Then the king went to his palace, and passed the night fasting; neither were instruments of music brought before him: and his sleep fled from him.
